pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Heterogeneous polygonal regions with moderate edge angularity. Individual patches on the mid-flank exhibit roughly four-to-six-sided geometries with soft pixel gradients at the margins. Relative spatial area of patches decreases significantly toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a web-like grid. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section but narrows toward the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The mane presents as a dense, dark-brown textural projection against the background sky.
